This simpler source result is explicitly included as uncounted support; no separate new functor-category task is made.
The Yoneda-image existence proof is not a separate new target here; the present theorem constructs the universal descent of arbitrary functors along weak equivalences.

That claim contracts connected/truncated map factorizations, whereas this proof descends category objects and arrows along merely essentially-surjective functors. Neither is a short corollary of the other.
Derived cohomological gluing uses negative Ext vanishing and injective strictification; this claim uses categorical univalence to eliminate truncated object choices.
